title: Ani-One Asia Streams Kaiju No. 8 'Narumi's Week at Work' Short Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced on Friday that it has licensed the new " Narumi's Week at Work " ("Narumi no Heijitsu") anime short of Naoya Matsumoto 's Kaiju No. 8 manga, and will begin streaming the anime on Saturday, September 5 at 7:00 p.m. GMT +8.

Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

Gen Narumi is captain of the Defense Force's First Division. Everyone says he's the strongest anti-Kaiju fighter in Japan. But his incredible strength makes him arrogant, and he's always missing meetings, dodging paperwork, and playing online games whenever he's got the chance. But sometimes, he meets an unexpected counterattack? This is a story of the not-so-peaceful work week of Japan's strongest man.

Kizuku Watanabe , the creator of the Kaiju No. 8: Relax spinoff manga, conceived the story of the " Narumi's Week at Work " short. The short will debut on September 5 in Japan and will have four episdoes that will launch on Saturdays at 8:00 p.m. JST on the TOHO animation channel. The final episode will debut on September 26.

The staff from the television anime is returning for this short, including director Shigeyuki Miya , character designer and chief animation director Tetsuya Nishio , musical composer Yūta Bandō , and the animation studio Production I.G . The other staff members include:

• Kaiju Designs: Mahiro Maeda

• Art Director: Shinji Kimura

• Color Key Artist: Izumi Hirose

• Compositing Director of Photography: Eiji Arai

• Sound Director: Fumiyuki Go

• Kaiju Designs & Design Works: Khara

Hayato Aragaki , the 3D director of the second television anime and the Kaiju No. 8: Hoshina's Day Off video anime, is returning in the same role for this new short. The television anime's editing assistant Yuka Yamajō is serving as the short's editor.

Kōki Uchiyama is once again voicing Gen Narumi.

The Kaiju No. 8 anime's first season premiered on TV Tokyo in April 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired. The anime streamed on X (formerly Twitter ) as well worldwide in real time as it aired on TV in Japan, at the exact time the anime aired.

The television anime's second season premiered on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels in July 2025. The second season also streamed on X (formerly Twitter ) worldwide in real time as it aired on TV in Japan. Ani-One Asia streamed the anime as it aired.
author: ANN

title: MVM Announces Date Changes
content:
MVM has announced in its X/Twitter feed that some of its upcoming home releases have been delayed. 2.5 Dimensional Seduction , pictured right, has gone back to October 26; I Parry Everything has gone back to November 23. Of the two volumes of Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia , Part 1 has gone back to October 12 and Part 2 to November 2.

October 12

October 19

October 26

November 23

title: Disney+ in UK Adds First 92 Episodes of One Piece
content:
The website AnimeBluRayUK reports the opening three TV anime seasons of One Piece , consisting of the first 92 episodes, are now available on Disney+ in the UK. The episodes are available both subtitled and English-dubbed.

The three seasons on Disney+ are "East Blue" (61 episodes), "Entering into the Grand Line" (16 episodes) and "Enter Chopper at the Winter Island" (15 episodes). These three seasons were the basis of the first two live-action One Piece seasons produced by Netflix .

According to AnimeBluRayUK , Disney+ is streaming the High Definition Remaster of the series, presented in widescreen aspect ratio.

The series is also streaming in the UK in its original 4:3 ratio on Crunchyroll and BBC iPlayer, while Netflix is streaming the HD version in widescreen.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless Second Anime Opening Featuring "BOYS & GIRLS" by LM.C
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its second opening, featuring the song “BOYS & GIRLS” by rock duo LM.C. The song was used in Episodes 27-51, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the second ending featuring “ONE NIGHT STAR” by The ARROWS . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the second entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Ha-young Exits Live-Action Trauma Code: Heroes on Call Season 2 Series
content:
Actress Ha-young will not return for the upcoming season of the webtoon-based live-action series The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call following controversy surrounding allegations about her great-grandfather's activities during the Japanese colonial period.

According to Korean newspaper Joong-ang Ilbo , Netflix confirmed on September 1 that Ha-young would not appear in the sequel, stating that it respects the actress's position.

Ha-young played nurse Jang-mi Cheon in the first season of The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call and had been expected to return for the follow-up seasons.

The controversy began after Ha-young appeared on a TV variety show and discussed her family's history as a four-generation medical family. Her great-grandfather, Sang-ho Ahn (1872–1927), was later identified as having collaborated with the Japanese colonial authorities during the Japanese colonial period, prompting controversy online.

Ha-young initially denied the allegations but later apologized after reviewing historical materials herself. She said she had learned about her great-grandfather's actions while researching the matter and expressed regret for discussing her family history without properly understanding the period.

Following the controversy, calls for Ha-young to leave several upcoming projects grew. She has now confirmed her departure from the The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call season 2.

The eight-episode first season of The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call debuted worldwide in January 2025 and became a breakout hit, topping Netflix 's global non-English TV show rankings and sparking strong demand for a sequel. The series is based on the web novel Trauma Center: Golden Hour , written by Han Sani, who is himself an ENT doctor.

The webtoon Trauma Center: Golden Hour is available in English on WEBTOON. The English version recently ended with an epilogue chapter on August 9.
author: ANN

title: Yowaki MAX Reijo Nano ni Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast, Theme Songs, October 4 Premiere
content:
The previously announced Yowaki MAX Reijo Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta (Even Though I’m a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé) anime revealed a new visual and trailer, along with the theme songs, additional cast, and October 4 premiere date.

The cast includes:

• Miku Ito as Pia Rockwell

• Ryota Osaka as Rufus Stan

• Rina Hidaka as Caroline Ramsey

• Sora Amamiya as Erin White

• Haruki Ishiya as Henry Cox

• Shizuka Ishigami as Rufus Stan (young)

• Haruka Shiraishi as Amelia (NEW)

• Shogo Sakata as Phillip (NEW)

• Shoya Ishige as Mike (NEW)

Konomi Suzuki performs the opening theme song “Goki MAX Sengen,” while Miku Ito sings the ending theme song “Yoake Made ni.” Both songs can be heard on the trailer:

Jumondo is animating the series with Nobuaki Nakanishi directing. Hiroko Fukuda is in charge of the series scripts, Hyun-Sik Choi is designing the characters and Moe Hyuga and Natsuki Hamada are composing the music.

Yowaki MAX Reijo Nano ni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta anime is based on a light novel by Hiro Oda. It was initially launched on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website. Enterbrain acquired the title under its B’s Log Bunko imprint, and the first volume was released in August 2020 with illustrations by Tsubasa.V. There is also a manga adaptation illustrated by Aji Murata. The story follows Pia, a timid young woman reincarnated as a minor villainess in an otome game, who tries to avoid her downfall by breaking off her engagement with Rufus, the prime minister’s son.

title: Webtoon-Based Short-Form Live-Action Series My Father's Table Set for September 9 Theatrical Release
content:
Director Joon-ik Lee's short-form live-action series My Father's Table , based on the Father's Home Meal webtoon by Gorita, will receive a theatrical release in South Korea on September 9.

Originally produced as a vertical-format short-form drama with episodes running approximately two minutes each, My Father's Table was re-edited into a feature-length theatrical presentation after screening at the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival in July.

The series follows a family whose dynamics shift after the mother is no longer able to cook, leading the father to take on the role for the first time. The original webtoon by Gorita focuses on family relationships and generational emotions through the theme of food.

Joon-ik Lee directs the adaptation, marking his first short-form project. The cast includes Jin-young Jung as the father, Jung-eun Lee as the mother, and Yo-han Byun as their son, along with Ji-yeon Park.

The original webtoon is currently not officially available in English.

The film will also be available on Lezhin Snack. A trailer for the series version is currently available with English subtitles on the Lezhin Snack website .

Lehzin announced the new Lezhin Snack platform on January 19. It is positioned as a dedicated short-video platform featuring video adaptations of proven webtoon IPs from Lezhin Comics and Bomtoon , alongside original titles developed specifically for the short-form format.

Lezhin Entertainment said the platform combines its experience in webtoon IP expansion with in-house video production know-how to deliver high-quality storytelling and direction within short runtimes. Production is supported by Kidari Studio , which brings experience in film investment, distribution, and content production, aiming to translate the narrative appeal of webtoons into fast-paced, immersive short dramas.
author: ANN

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd STAGE New Preview Images Revealed
content:
STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure 2ND STAGE revealed new preview images ahead of its September 25 premiere on Netflix. The anime previously confirmed 11 episodes for stages 2 and 3, along with weekly streaming .

The new released images preview Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli as they take on a roughly 750-mile desert crossing during the Steel Ball Run race. The route includes an area feared as the “Devil’s Palm,” and the description mentions that a series of unsettling incidents begins to reveal that the race is more than a simple competition. The new announcement was made during a special live stream looking back on the 1st STAGE.

Three new characters and their voice cast were previously introduced and set to appear in the next installment of the anime:

• Tomoaki Maeno as Mountain Tim

• Tomokazu Sugita as Funny Valentine

• Yoko Hikasa as Hot Pants

Steel Ball Run is the seventh part of Hirohiko Araki’s legendary JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure manga. Set in late 19th-century America, the story follows former prodigy jockey Johnny Joestar and mysterious outlaw Gyro Zeppeli as they compete in a transcontinental horse race for a massive cash prize. Beneath the surface, however, they face dangerous conspiracies that threaten to take over the competition. The first episode was a 47-minute special covering Stage 1 of the race, and it released on March 19, 2026. You can watch the latest trailer below.

Also check out the English dub version of the trailer:

The manga by Hirohiro Araki began in 1987, while the Steel Ball Run part ran from 2004 to 2011. The full staff for the latest anime installment includes:

• Director: Yasuhiro Kimura & Hideya Takahashi (Golden Wind)

• Series Director: Toshiyuki Kato (Every Series)

• Series Structure: Yasuko Kobayashi (Every Series)

• Character Design: Daisuke Tsumagari (Golden Wind)

• Music: Yugo Kanno (Stardust Crusaders, Diamond is Unbreakable, Golden Wind, Stone Ocean)

• Sound Director: Yoshikazu Iwanami (Every Series)

• Animation: david production (Every Series)

A key visual for the 2nd STAGE was previously revealed.

title: Romelia War Chronicle TV Anime Reveals 14 More Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of Ryō Ariyama 's Romelia War Chronicle: Even After Defeating the Demon King, Humanity Still Seems Doomed, So I Formed a Military Force ( Romelia Senki: Maō o Taoshita Ato mo Jinrui Yabasō Dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita ) light novel series revealed 14 more cast members on Friday.

The newly announced cast includes (from left to right in each image below):

• Hiromichi Tezuka as Hans

• Tomohiro Yamaguchi as Glein

• Ryūichi Hirose as Jinni

• Kenta Hosoda as Tarth

• Tasuku Kaito as Say

• Rikuya Yasuda as Zeze

• Hiroki Matsukawa as Bray

• Taiki Yamashita as Ben

• Sōhei Horikane as Gatt

• Naoki Sakurai as Rhett

• Mizuki Ishii as Shuro

• Hayato Kimura as Merrill

• Shuntaro Hara as Borel

• Hiromu Mineta as Miitya

This year's Otakon event screened the world premiere on July 31.

The cast includes:

• Yuna Nemoto as Romelia von Graham

• Jin Ogasawara as Al

• Tomohiro Ōno as Ray

• Yūya Hirose as Henri Lleus Lionel

• Sayaka Senbongi as Elizabeth

• Mariya Ise as Ekaterina

• Asaka as Ryoki

• Shōya Chiba as Gran

• Gakuto Kajiwara as Ragn

• Shun Horie as Kyle

• Ryūnosuke Watanuki as Otto

The anime's staff includes:

• Director: Hiroshi Shirai (unit director for Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero)

• Assistant Director: Takahiro Hirata (episode director for The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You first two seasons)

• Series Composition & Screenplay: Aya Satsuki (Solo Camping for Two, A Girl & Her Guard Dog)

• Character Design: Yoshiko Saitō / Yūta Ōtaka

• Art Director: Masakazu Miyake

• Color Design: Yuki Kadomatsu (Stella)

• Director of Photography: Megumi Himeno (GRAPHINICA)

• Photography: GRAPHINICA

• Editing: Misato Takikawa (REAL-T)

• Sound Director: Daiki Yamaki (Klang Klang)

• Sound Effects: Daiki Ogawa (SOUND BOX)

• Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion

• Music: KOHTA YAMAMOTO

• Music Production: PONY CANYON

• Animation Production: Atra

Ariyama launched the light novel series as a web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, before being published under Shogakukan 's Gagaga Bunko imprint. The series currently has over 550,000 copies in circulation, and ended in its sixth volume in November 2025. Kodama illustrated the first novel volume and Ryō Kamito illustrated volumes 2-6.

The manga series adaptation with art by Ryō Kamito launched on Mag Garden 's Mag Comi platform in January 2022.

Seven Seas licensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

Seven Seas released the third volume on August 11.

Ariyama launched the light novel series as a web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, before being published under Shogakukan 's Gagaga Bunko imprint. The series currently has over 550,000 copies in circulation, and ended in its sixth volume in November 2025. Kodama illustrated the first novel volume and Ryō Kamito illustrated volumes 2-6.
The manga series adaptation with art by Ryō Kamito launched on Mag Garden 's Mag Comi platform in January 2022.
Seven Seas licensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.
Seven Seas released the third volume on August 11.
